degree.text: Degree Awarded Bachelor of Engineering Degree

description.text: Teaching Objective The program aims to set market as the principle and set different professional directions under this major, such as vehicle control, detection technology and instrument, test technology and information processing, technology of measurement and control and bilingual teaching etc, which are multiple choices and satisfy the need of career in society. Main Courses Circuit Principle Analog Electronic Technology Digital electronic technology Signals and systems Engineering drawing Automatic detection technology and instrument control system Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design. Degree Awarded Bachelor of Engineering Degree

duration.text: The Detection and Control Technology and Instrument at China University of Petroleum (Huadong) is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Academic transcript of high school 4. Graduation certificate of high school Gradution certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not,it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or above, or have passed Grade Twelve (10+2)/FSc./A Level/WAEC or equivalent. 2. Aged 18 or above 3. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport
